description:
Put five next steps on a card, as five tiles the person can click. Call it only at the END of a skill that tells you to, never to work out what the person should do.

This tool ranks nothing: pass the five skills of well_get_session_digest's `suggested_steps`, in that order. When that list is empty or shorter than five, do NOT call it and do not write five of your own: say in one line that the next steps cannot be proposed this time.

Each step is `skill` (a slug exactly as well_search_skill lists it) and `prompt`: one natural sentence, 1 to 160 characters, in the person's language, written from that skill's quoted trigger utterances and the digest's figures, as what the PERSON would say. A tile shows only the skill's catalog title and promise, so put the figure in the sentence. Never pass `define-workspace`, `define-period`, `normalize-currency`, `signing-back` or `whats-next`, a prompt that starts with "/", contains "<" or a line break, or the same skill twice: the server refuses them.

Only the welcome of a person's first session passes `first_session: true`: each tile then shows your sentence as its title, so each is a short job of 8 words or fewer. Only that welcome, when its skill says so, passes `demo_choice: true`, with exactly 1 real-data step; on reason "demo_choice_unavailable", call again without `demo_choice`, with the five steps. Otherwise always pass five steps, never add or drop one for a step the server adds itself; the result says what it added.

The card renders where this call sits in the turn: write everything you have to say BEFORE calling. After it, make only the well_wait_for_selection call the result's `next_step` field spells out, in this same turn: on "selected", take selection.next_step.prompt as the person's own message and start selection.next_step.skill at once, loading it with well_get_skill. Prose in place of that call ends the turn, and the click then has to restart the work from a new message rather than continue this one. Every tile stays clickable while the card is on screen.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

demo_choice.description: True only when the welcome of a first session offers the demo and real data as two equal options: pass one real-data step, and the server adds the demo step first. Omit it on every other card.

first_session.description: True only when the welcome skill draws the card of a person's first session: each tile then shows its sentence as the title. Omit it on every other card.

steps.description: Exactly 5 steps, in the order the card lists them; exactly 1 real-data step with demo_choice.

prompt.description: One sentence the person can send as is, written from the skill's own quoted trigger utterances. Refused when it starts with "/", contains "<", or contains a line break.

skill.description: The id of the skill this step offers, as well_search_skill lists it.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Optional: this tool describes the token itself rather than one workspace's data, so omitting it returns the same answer.

workspace_scope.description: Restrict this call to the family: the token's primary workspace plus the company workspaces under it that you are a member of. Unrelated authorized workspaces drop out of the read; row reads merge across the family, while a per-workspace figure still reports exactly one workspace.

name: well_propose_next_steps

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. The connected-line rule says when to tell an entry; when it does, one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

next_step.description: What to do with the card this result renders. Added by the dispatcher when the card asks for a click.

title: Propose next steps
